PROTOROBOT
Meetup #0

Proto Robot #0Prague, 23.10.2026

PROTO ROBOT is a new series of meetups for people who build robots, and #0 is the first one. Talks, live demos, beer and conversation. A community for anyone in Prague working on hardware, autonomy, robot learning or the tools around them. Bring what you're working on, show it, and see what everyone else has on the bench.

Friday 23 October, 6 to 10 pm. Free entry, registration required. Talks are in Czech and English.

Free entryRegisterFree entryRegisterFree entryRegisterFree entryRegisterFree entryRegisterFree entryRegisterFree entryRegisterFree entryRegister

Program

Talks

Short talks from people shipping real machines: humanoids, cobots, drones, autonomy stacks. Twenty minutes each. Speakers are being confirmed.

Demos

Bring the thing itself. A table, power and a room full of people who will ask the right questions. Half-finished is fine. That's the point.

18:00

Doors open. Grab a beer, walk the demo tables, find the people whose repo you've been reading.

19:00

Talks on stage, then demos on the floor. The exact timetable goes out a week before the event.

21:00

Hangout until 22:00. Beer and talking shop. We have a lot to discuss. And that's why robot.
